darwin-origin/ch09-10: 'Edentata' (obsolete order) resolved to Xenarthra. GBIF backbone lists Xenarthra (10998477) as a synonym at order rank.

thompson-growth-form/ch06-11: GBIF usage found by exact-name lookup in the backbone (status DOUBTFUL), not by the match API. GBIF marks this usage doubtful. PBDB: Zaphrentis is subjective synonym of Zaphrenthis.

thompson-growth-form/ch08: Extinct rugose coral genus Zaphrentis Rafinesque & Clifford, 1820. GBIF backbone and Wikidata use the original spelling 'Zaphrenthis' (5430158 accepted; 'Zaphrentis' usages 8131888/4575293 are DOUBTFUL); WoRMS (1457937, extinct) and PBDB use 'Zaphrentis'.
